stem.text: Which statement explains why buckminsterfullerene has a lower melting point than graphite?

A.text: Buckminsterfullerene exists as discrete molecules with weak intermolecular bonding.

B.text: Graphite is partly ionic as its structure contains mobile electrons and it conducts electricity.

C.text: The carbon–carbon bonds in buckminsterfullerene are shorter and more strained.

D.text: The mobile electrons in graphite mean it has a metallic structure.
